split.description: Use all 1,000 source leave-one-unfamiliar-face-out folds: 999 unfamiliar training faces, one omitted unfamiliar query and 36 familiar queries in every fold. metric.description: Pearson correlation across actual versus decoded feature coordinates for each face-vector pair, higher is better. Preserve 1,000 unfamiliar values and 1,000 by 36 familiar values at every population/time/control coordinate; do not replace with face-level MSE or absolute correlation.

aggregation.description: Recover original Figure 2d reduction over familiar query folds, faces, cells/populations, time and ten shuffle repetitions and its uncertainty.
